full_track.tags: K-Pop Funk with a disco-influenced arrangement. The track features a syncopated slap bass line, clean-toned rhythmic electric guitar scratching, and a bright acoustic piano playing staccato chords. The drum kit uses a crisp snare and a tight hi-hat pattern. Male vocals alternate between a chest-voice tenor and a light falsetto. A subtle synth pad provides harmonic density in the background. The tempo is 118 BPM in the key of G Major. The arrangement utilizes sudden stops and rhythmic stabs for dynamic contrast.
